subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from requireMention group messages that did not address the bot, and what bounds should govern that media?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes what sensitive unmentioned group media may be downloaded, retained, and later sent into model context.

options.title: Approve bounded retention
options.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized local image history media under existing group/context visibility limits, with tight TTL/count bounds, safe path handling, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep text-only no-download behavior
options.body: Treat unmentioned group media as intentionally private and document that mention-gated Telegram history can include placeholders without replayable media.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Add a narrow default-off policy only if maintainers decide existing historyLimit and contextVisibility controls are not enough for this boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded retention
recommendation.body: Allow a fix that records only authorized local image history media under existing group/context visibility limits, with tight TTL/count bounds, safe path handling, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged current behavior that skips unmentioned Telegram media before download, so they are the best current routing candidate for the boundary choice.
